meta.scope: First Germany edition: 21 selected major domestic and international city pairs. Not an inventory of every German service or operator. Local, S-Bahn, metro, tram and tourist networks are outside this directory. Listed offerings may include connections.
meta.timing_note: Published fastest journey times from linked booking/operator pages. Figures are indicative snapshots, not a dated itinerary; construction, stations, stops and travel date can change them. Operator filters show the source-specific figure.
meta.distance_note: Distances retain the source basis. Most are booking-page city-pair figures and are not railway-path mileage; FlixTrain journey figures are identified separately. Do not use them for live train kilometres remaining.
meta.license_note: Selected facts from linked public route pages; city locations and outlines from Natural Earth.

services.basis: Fastest journey advertised by booking source; date-dependent, may include a connection. Not an operator-specific guarantee.
Operator-advertised minimum journey time; confirm dated train service

distance.note: Minimum journey distance advertised by FlixTrain. It applies to its listed city-pair offering, not every DB route or stopping pattern; not certified track chainage.

distance.note: City-pair distance reported by SNCF Connect. Several figures are shorter than a rail alignment and should not be treated as railway mileage. Train-path distances depend on service; not suitable for kilometres-to-go calculations.
